items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I don't know who that kind of man was. ... They were good. I was a right young fellow when I'm talking about him.

ctx.x: I don't know who that kind of man was.
He had a partner called Nookie Johnson or something.
They were good. I was a right young fellow when I'm talking about him.
